resources.string: App verification failed for visual analysis
App verification could not complete. Check internet access. Use the internal build on an emulator; on a physical phone, the app signature and Play Integrity verification need to be checked.
Check internet access and the Firebase App Check device registration for this test installation. Do not uninstall the app or clear its data.
The visual analysis service API key is invalid
Update the Gemini API key on the Raspberry Pi with a valid key. Do not enter the key in the app or in chat. This is not a Tailscale connection error.
The visual analysis provider rejected the request
The Raspberry Pi service was reached, but the AI provider returned an error. Check the server API key, model and quota settings.
